question: A freelancer on a Pro plan has built a project with detailed instructions and reference documents, and now wants two collaborators to work inside the same project. What should they expect?
options: A) Sharing becomes available once the project contains uploaded documents rather than instructions alone.
B) Sharing works on every plan, so the collaborators can simply be invited with view or edit access.
C) Sharing works only after the project has been archived, which makes it visible to other accounts.
D) Project sharing is a Team and Enterprise capability, so on a Pro plan the project stays personal.
correct_answers: D) Project sharing is a Team and Enterprise capability, so on a Pro plan the project stays personal.
explanations: What a project contains has no bearing on whether it can be shared.
Personal plans do not offer project sharing with other people.
Archiving tidies a project away; it does not publish it to anyone.
Correct. Sharing projects with named colleagues is available on Team and Enterprise plans only.
